title: ResultManifest
description: Schema for the agent result manifest. Captures the outcome of a task execution including status, standards applied, outputs produced, assumptions made, unknowns identified, validation results, and handoff recommendation.

request_id.description: Unique identifier of the originating request, matching the input manifest.

agent_version.description: Version of the agent that produced this result.

skill_versions.description: Versions of each skill invoked during task execution.

task_type.description: The task type processed, matching the input manifest task_type.

status.description: Overall status of the task result.

standards_applied.description: Standards consulted and applied during task execution.

owner.description: Owning team or authority for the standard.

review_status.description: Review or approval status of the standard (e.g. current_approved, draft, expired).

source_url.description: URL to the authoritative source of the standard.

input_fingerprints.description: Checksums of input artefacts consumed during execution, for traceability.

path.description: Path or URI of the input artefact.

sha256.description: SHA-256 checksum of the input artefact at time of consumption.

outputs.description: Artefacts produced by the agent during this task execution.

path.description: File path or URI of the output artefact.

checksum.description: Checksum of the output artefact for integrity verification.

assumptions.description: Assumptions made during task execution that affect the outputs.

severity.description: Severity of the assumption on the output quality or correctness.

evidence_state.description: Whether the assumption is evidenced, inferred, or unverified.

unknowns.description: Items that could not be resolved and require further clarification or human input.

description.description: Description of what is unknown or unresolved.

severity.description: Severity of the unknown on the task outcome.

owner_needed.description: Role or team that needs to resolve this unknown.

warnings.description: Non-blocking warnings raised during task execution.

blocking_findings.description: Findings that block acceptance of the outputs and require remediation.

id.description: Unique identifier for this blocking finding.

control_ref.description: Reference to the control or standard that was not met.

severity.description: Severity level of the blocking finding.

validations.description: Results of validation checks performed on the outputs.

validator.description: Name or identifier of the validator or check performed.

result.description: Result of the validation (e.g. pass, fail, warn).

details.description: Additional details or findings from the validation.

evidence_refs.description: References to evidence sources consulted or cited during task execution.

id.description: Unique identifier for this evidence reference.

source.description: URL or identifier of the evidence source.

retrieved_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the evidence was retrieved.

authority_status.description: Authority status of the evidence (e.g. VERIFIED_STANDARD, ASSUMPTION).

handoff_recommendation.description: Recommended next action or handoff instruction for the human reviewer.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this result manifest was produced.
